title: Step 5b: Logistic Regression - Linear Classifiers & Prediction Boundaries

cues.en: Instructor: Now, the other very important thing to understand is that these are two prediction regions separated by a straight line, which is the straight line here.
cues.zh: 另一個重要概念，是兩個預測區域由直線分隔，就是這條線。

cues.en: And the straight line is called the prediction boundary because it's the boundary between the two prediction regions.
cues.zh: 它叫預測邊界，因為位於兩個預測區域之間。

cues.en: And the fact that it's a straight line is not random.
cues.zh: 是直線並非偶然。

cues.en: It is for a particular reason and that's the thing very important to understand because that's the essence of logistic regression.
cues.zh: 有特定原因，這很重要，也是邏輯斯迴歸的本質。

cues.en: If the prediction boundary is a straight line here, that's because our logistic regression classifier is a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 邊界是直線，是因為邏輯斯迴歸是線性分類器。

cues.en: That means that here, since we are in two dimensions, because we have two independent variable, the age and the estimated salary, so we are in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 有年齡和估計薪資兩個自變數，所以現在是二維。

cues.en: Then since the logistic regression classifier is a linear classifier, then the prediction boundary separator here can only be a straight line.
cues.zh: 線性分類器在二維中，預測分隔邊界只能是直線。

cues.en: If we were in three dimensions, then it would be a straight planes separating two spaces.
cues.zh: 若是三維，就會是分隔兩個空間的平面。

cues.en: But here in two dimensions it's a straight line and it will always be a straight line if your classifier is a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 但這裡二維，線性分類器的邊界永遠是直線。

cues.en: But you will see later that when we build non-linear classifiers, then the prediction boundary separator won't be a straight line anymore.
cues.zh: 之後建立非線性分類器時，邊界就不再是直線。

cues.en: I won't tell you more right now and I will let you wait for the surprise.
cues.zh: 現在先不說，留點驚喜。

cues.en: So here we can clearly see that our logistic regression and classifier managers to catch most of the users who didn't buy the SUV in the red region here
cues.zh: 可以清楚看到，邏輯斯迴歸成功將大部分沒買 SUV 的人放在紅區，

cues.en: and most of the users who bought the SUV in the green region here.
cues.zh: 買了的人放在綠區。

cues.en: So it actually did a pretty good job, however it seems to have trouble catching some green users here who in spite of their low salary bought the luxury SUV,
cues.zh: 整體做得不錯，但無法抓到某些低薪、卻買了豪華 SUV 的綠點，

cues.en: as well as those other green users here who also bought the luxury SUV.
cues.zh: 以及這邊其他買車的綠點。

cues.en: Because as you can see, these green points here and those here are in the red region, which is a region where our classifier predicts that the users don't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 因為這些綠點都落在紅區，也就是模型預測不買的地方。

cues.en: And those incorrect predictions are used specifically to the fact that our classifier is a linear classifier and because our users are not linearly distributed.
cues.zh: 這些錯誤特別是因為分類器線性，但使用者分布不是線性可分。

cues.en: If they were linearly distributed, then we will have all the green points here in this space and all the red points here in this space.
cues.zh: 如果線性可分，綠點都在這邊、紅點都在另一邊，

cues.en: And then a linear classifier with a straight line could perfectly separate all the red points here and all the green points here.
cues.zh: 那麼直線分類器就能完美區分。

cues.en: But here we have some rebellious points who are not in the wanted linear regions.
cues.zh: 但這裡有些叛逆的點，不在期望的線性區域。

cues.en: And because our classifier has linear straight line separator, that's why it has trouble catching those users here and those here.
cues.zh: 分類器只能用直線，所以無法正確抓到這些人。

cues.en: You can clearly see that even if you try to rotate this straight line here, well, you will always have some green points in the wrong category.
cues.zh: 就算旋轉直線，仍會有綠點在錯誤類別。

cues.en: For example, if we try to rotate here this way, like putting it down, well okay, we will catch these green points here in the right green region here, but since we rotate it down,
cues.zh: 例如往下旋轉，可以讓這些綠點進入綠區；但因另一端往上，

cues.en: we will take more green users here because this will go up and more green users here will be in the red region.
cues.zh: 又會讓更多綠點落入紅區。

cues.en: So that's the best separator, the logistic regression classifier could find.
cues.zh: 所以這已是模型找到的最佳分隔線。

cues.en: And it couldn't do better because it can only be a straight line separating these two regions.
cues.zh: 沒辦法更好，因為只能使用直線。

cues.en: Because to catch those users, the green users here and the green users here in the right category that is the green region are classifier would need to make some kind of a curve here
cues.zh: 若想把兩邊綠點都分到正確綠區，分類器需要畫出某種曲線，

cues.en: to classify correctly those green users here and here and place them in a green region.
cues.zh: 才能把這些人正確放入綠區。

cues.en: And that would prevent our classifier from making this incorrect predictions here because it is a straight line.
cues.zh: 這樣可避免直線造成的錯誤。

cues.en: With a curve here, we would catch all the red users properly in the red region and all the green users in the green region.
cues.zh: 曲線能把紅點都放進紅區、綠點都放進綠區。

cues.en: So that would make an awesome classifier.
cues.zh: 那會是很棒的分類器。

cues.en: And you will see how our non-linear classifiers will make a terrific job at doing this.
cues.zh: 之後會看到非線性分類器如何出色完成。

cues.en: I can't wait to show you this.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待想示範。

cues.en: And now eventually the last thing very important to understand is that this is the training set.
cues.zh: 最後一個重要概念，是這張圖來自訓練集。

cues.en: This is a training set, so that means that our classifier learned how to classify based on these informations here.
cues.zh: 所以分類器就是根據這些資訊學習。

cues.en: So I would hold my breath a few more seconds until I find out if our logistic regression classifier can manage to make good predictions of new observations.
cues.zh: 我會再等幾秒，直到確認模型對新觀測也能預測良好。

cues.en: That is to classify new users into the right regions, which by the way, our fixed regions here because these are the regions generated by the learning experience of our logistic regression classifier
cues.zh: 也就是將新使用者放入正確區域。區域其實已固定，由模型訓練

cues.en: and therefore won't change if we look at some new observations that is new social network users.
cues.zh: 決定，不會因出現新的社群使用者而改變。

cues.en: And that's what we are about to find out on the test set.
cues.zh: 現在要透過測試集確認。

cues.en: So hold on.
cues.zh: 稍等。

cues.en: So it's very simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: We're just going to copy all this code section here, paste it here.
cues.zh: 複製這整段程式，貼到這裡。

cues.en: And I'm just going to change the training set here by test set.
cues.zh: 將 training_set 換成 test_set。

cues.en: Same here, I change training set by test set, and that's all.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣，就這樣。

cues.en: That's all because I structured the codes in such a way that we only need to change the training set into the test set here to plot this graph on a specific set.
cues.zh: 因為程式已設計好，要畫特定資料集，只改這個名稱即可。

cues.en: However, let's change the title here because we wanna specify that it's the test set, and it's ready.
cues.zh: 不過圖表標題也改成 Test Set，然後準備好了。

cues.en: So let's select this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取並執行。

cues.en: Let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: And here are the results of the test set.
cues.zh: 這是測試集。

cues.en: So that's not too bad, that's not too bad because as we can see the majority of red points are in the right region.
cues.zh: 不錯，大部分紅點都在正確區域，

cues.en: That means the region predicted to be zero and the majority of green points are in the right region.
cues.zh: 也就是預測 0 的區域；大部分綠點也在正確區域。

cues.en: As per the training set, there are some observations that were incorrectly predicted.
cues.zh: 和訓練集一樣，仍有一些錯誤預測。

cues.en: That's normal.
cues.zh: 正常。

cues.en: That's because it's a linear classifier and it cannot make a curve here catching all the right guys.
cues.zh: 因為是線性分類器，不能畫曲線將所有人都抓對。

cues.en: All right, so that's it for the interpretation of the graph.
cues.zh: 以上就是圖形解讀。

cues.en: I can't wait to show you how we can make more powerful classifiers.
cues.zh: 期待示範更強大的分類器。

cues.en: And of course these are gonna be non-linear classifiers.
cues.zh: 當然就是非線性分類器。
